policy.reason: Third-party skills are loaded only when they reduce work for the current stage and never define product scope.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.reason: Targeted browser testing; bundled helper is designed to run as a black box and reduce context. Playwright dependency may require setup only when this stage needs it.

skills.name: codebase-migrate
skills.reason: Requires Composio plus issue/PR ceremony and duplicates the local mission/refactor workflow.

skills.name: create-plan
skills.reason: Mission stages already provide the plan; another planner duplicates context.

skills.name: deploy-pipeline
skills.reason: Its Stripe-oriented deployment flow conflicts with Sergod's Flow/Webpay + Render architecture.

skills.name: gh-fix-ci
skills.reason: May be reconsidered in hardening only if GitHub Actions failures exist; current workflow asks for approval and adds unnecessary interaction.

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.reason: No custom MCP is justified yet. Reconsider only after measuring a repeated deterministic operation that scripts cannot cover.

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.reason: Sergod has its own visual authority and approved assets.

skills.name: multi-agent-orchestrators
skills.reason: Bernstein/Polywave/AuraKit-style orchestration is contrary to single-agent-by-default efficiency.
